description:
Follow-ups from the four CC-REV-1 rounds of PR #532 (syzygy-bpyt.4.5). Raws: docs/reviews/R-GP-IMPL-TEST-CLOCKS-1..4-RAW.md; round 4 CONFIRM WITH EXCEPTIONS over 23af2d08 cleared the bytes. Dispositions: docs/evidence/test-clocks-round-4-dispositions-2026-10-28.md. The reviewers' tools are under docs/evidence/test-clocks-review-2026-10-27/r1..r4/.
Any edit to packages/cap1-system/src/daemon-entry-unchanged.system.test.ts changes bytes the four daemon-entry runs bind (docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-4-5/tools/build_record.py:83-85), so re-run those runs and rebuild the record in the same PR, as a new record beside the landed one.
1. Round 1 N5 (pre-existing): daemon-path loads that neither the old pin nor the new rows catch; a hook row over island prefixes, a machine route and/or a static createRequire refusal.
2. Round 1 N6 (pre-existing): the text row fails a type-only import; skip import type lines.
3. Round 3 N1: a then-block that falls through after the branch's own import (Y1b) passes the new test and the old pin.
4. Round 3 N2 and round 4 N2: build_record checks neither the >=10 head runs, nor that every timed test line was measured, nor each site's mutant-row population (round 4's M5, a deleted row, builds green). Declare the row list per bound beside UNREACHED, or read cpu_separation.py's SITES with ast, and add M5 as a fail case to build_record_mutants.py.
5. Round 3 N3: emit_equal.mjs is sound for type-only edits, but the claim it backs is wider than what it compares; state the claim it proves.
6. Round 3 N4: the compiler-API row matches each condition as text, and its failure messages do not name the defect.
7. Round 4 N1: the test comment's list of the pin's known false refusals (:276) leaves out round 3's G1 (Allman brace, wrapped import) and G2 (block comments around else and in the condition). Reword to 'Among its false refusals' and add them; add G1-G3 to daemon_entry_probe.py as equivalents from docs/evidence/test-clocks-review-2026-10-27/r3/tools/r3_variants.py and extend PIN_FALSE_REFUSALS.
8. Round 4 N4: the compiler-API row's comment (:242) opens 'The kept part of the old text pin'; the whole pin is kept below it. Open it 'The compiler-API text row.'
Round 1 N7, round 2 N3 and round 3 N5 (full-suite timeouts under load in untouched files) belong to syzygy-bpyt.4.40, not here. Test-only; no gate change.
design:
[Inferred proposal; first static shaping of syzygy-bpyt.43, not syzygy-bpyt.4.43] Complete the eight PR532 follow-ups in the unchanged canonical description as one test/evidence correction. Keep the description, historical qualifications, all comments, title, type, owner, priority, labels, notes and dependency identities intact. The current canonical design and acceptance_criteria are absent, so there is no existing AC text to replace; a newly discovered prefix must be preserved verbatim. No sibling is completed by this task. R1 N7, R2 N3 and R3 N5 remain syzygy-bpyt.4.40's full-suite-timeout outcome. Historical round 4 CONFIRM WITH EXCEPTIONS cleared its exact repair bytes under that round's notes-only stopping rule; it neither clears this successor nor licenses skipping these notes.

[Observed primary authority] OWNER-DIRECTION-GREENFIELD-PARITY-ANSWERS-2026-10-21.md GP-Q0 Part 1 confirms: “Behavior-preserving refactors may proceed under the acts already in force.” Its boundary preserves rendered bytes, wire formats, refusal strings, exit codes, signed/digest-bound artifacts and consent/security/retention decisions. Its last Part-3 sentence says: “Any change not listed here to what a gate accepts or refuses stops and returns to the owner.” This bead improves tests and evidence-check predicates for existing behavior; it authorizes no production gate/output/security change. The 2026-10-20 simplification direction items 2–3 supplies the implementation-plane/improvement-cycle route; the established POC direction continues to govern any actual POC work, including shared-model WIP one and the cycle report. No authority is acquired from a raw review or an evidence-tool docstring. CC-REV-1 requires an independent fresh-context reviewer and makes class membership contested; CC-BAR-5 says “Seven floors bound every change”; CC-BAR-6 scales evidence above those floors. CC-TEST-1/2/4/5 and CC-REV-6 govern regression, capture, failures, proof scope and unchanged raws. VIS-2 and the trust-and-evidence doctrine keep missing current proof Unknown. A genuine unlisted product acceptance/refusal or normative/security/retention change is a concrete governing gate, not an engineering choice to infer away. Routine preparation, reconciliation and drafting need no new owner question.

[Observed baseline; runtime Unknown] The shaping subject is the clean assigned agent/syzygy-bpyt tree at 1396de2df4254094a432e2a8148f5d5ca4349e7e. The canonical child has eight numbered items, no comments and no AC/design field. The daemon-entry test still has its load-hook row, compiler-API text row and restored literal pin. The compiler row compares condition getText to a literal and scans all app mentions, including a type-only declaration. The evidence builder accepts a nonempty headRuns population, derives its bound denominator from the producer's own sites, and has no exact per-bound (id,title) mutant-row check. The historical separation sources name three files/four bounds with one/one/three/one mutant pairs; those are historical, not a current timing claim. Static inspection at this head locates current assertion lines at dossier-profile.test.ts:194, excerpt.test.ts:273 and test-artifact-verification.test.ts:103/110; a whole-population runtime/census reconciliation is still required. The existing island-boundary.test.ts already has a 24-module island list and finite syntax handling for computed/import-equals/require/createRequire forms, including imported aliases. Reuse its actual protection and re-prove the residuals; do not reimplement a resolved guard based on an old raw. SOURCE-IDENTITIES.json in the shaping handoff records the exact input blobs/hashes and historical record subjects; it proves no execution result.

[Inferred source and custody boundary] Primary future edit surface is packages/cap1-system/src/daemon-entry-unchanged.system.test.ts. Extend its existing behavioral hook and compiler-API row; retain the literal pin's load protection and accepted false-refusal cost. Supporting edits, only if actual residual evidence requires them, belong at the existing packages/polaris-generation-core/src/island-boundary.test.ts/workspace-reach.testkit.ts seam, not in a new loader engine. Product main.ts, state-directory.ts and http-host/shutdown.ts are read/mutation subjects in private clones, not production repair targets. Copy and adapt the historical evidence tools into a new docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-43/ successor directory (or its newly owned scratch execution copy), with old-to-new path/field/row mappings and a new record beside the predecessor. Never edit or execute an old wrapper that overwrites/restores historical records, append to frozen logs, move old tools, or rewrite docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-4-5/, the r1–r4 reviewer tools, the four raws or the landed dispositions. A deliberate successor may change its own expectations as the rows improve, but must not relabel old evidence or silently inherit now-false pin-only/equivalent/residual claims.

[Observed allocation snapshot; Inferred sequencing] Two independent live path enumerations (gh PR files and gh pr diff --name-only) reconcile every returned path for 17 open PRs. None of those path sets includes the primary daemon-entry test or the two named island-guard files; this is a dated 17-PR observation, not assurance against later/outside activity. PR585 at 3c30b2e24d3e27a81492dd9d874dc1c348a57b61 owns other cap1-system tests and CAP1 routes/lockfile; PR763 at 88b502e7060a4013b7932f0cb3771cb2e2dbe06b owns the app browser lifetime seam; PR761 at 348e51676a8c74b28962eed0f420bf53806e4370 owns PWB reader/fence seams; PR754 at 36bcc375b24e6ebc9537506893b26bf8d45e82b7 owns dossier rendering/review; PR743 at aca61f97b283908740c0d31caa4d758e54e6089f owns Git observation/transport; PR652 at 5a1240805ce7e4a2a4aca89a1ce8559d13e70a4c owns the execution-choice/CLI change. They are not absorbed. Root must refresh exact source/PR/Beads ownership and allocate one accountable writer before implementation; any additional shared file selected by diagnosis needs a concrete serial handoff and agreed integration base. Preserve higher-ranked/foreign/owner-held work: the first .8.25 shaping does not preempt parent .8 already held for .8.31; this packet neither changes the DAG nor repeats earlier shaping. .4.14 browser lifetime, .4.40 timeouts and .4.43's distinct outcome remain with their owners. Existing PR metadata is provenance, never a grant.

[Inferred daemon-load matrix; original items 1–3] Reconcile R1 N5's computed provider-island createRequire load and unexercised transitive request path against the current island guard. Extend the existing hook to the actual island module prefix population (mapped from the existing island list rather than guessed package roots), drive a machine route as well as / with fixture-owned authentication and a positive loading control, and/or extend the existing static guard's actual missing loader predicate. The selected mechanism must demonstrably kill each original residual, not only one easy spelling. Include the moved closeOnSignal close-failure residual X2 from R2 N1, and re-target P-shutdown/P-close-failure to actual current X1/X2/X3 source fragments on the next probe. Keep unsupported loader forms explicit and fail closed; do not claim finite syntax handling is general JavaScript alias analysis. No observed repository is used and no provider call is made. Make type-only import declarations (including the original E-type-only-import) invisible to the repaired runtime naming predicate, preserving runtime/value-import detection. Do not silently convert C1 or a retained literal-pin refusal into a passing equivalent. Record per-row and whole-suite outcomes separately: the historical pin can still have an explicitly disclosed false refusal even when the compiler row correctly passes. Close Y1b, which adds no app mention after the branch's own import, with a bounded control-flow predicate at the existing compiler row. Follow the original reviewer matrix: the branch paths cannot fall through into the daemon after loading, re-enter main, escape via an outer break/continue, or schedule the demonstrated callback while falling through. Check the actual const argv = process.argv.slice(2) binding and process.argv mutations that permit those counterexamples. The predicate must kill Y1–Y5 and Y1b and pass L1–L3/G1–G4 at that row. Do not retire the restored pin on assertion alone; this task's comment and PIN_FALSE_REFUSALS obligations still apply. A broader pin-retirement project is not silently substituted for the eight items.

[Inferred record population matrix; original item 4] In the new build_record successor enforce len(headRuns) >= 10 per bound on both the thread-CPU and Node22 process-fallback evidence arms, with successful nonempty expected region observations, not a top-level count or aggregate across bounds. Derive the full timed-test file/line/bound identity population independently from the committed head census or an independently checked source sweep for the CPU assertions. Reconcile that population to each separation's sites/lines, including parameter rows/regions; no denominator may come only from the separation being checked. Pin the exact per-bound sorted (id,title) mutant list with multiplicity before the UNREACHED check: choose either a literal beside UNREACHED or AST-read SITES at the evidence commit; resolve its constants safely, never import/execute the producer to discover expectations. Keep the producer's expected list independently reviewable so producer and checker cannot silently shrink together. Preserve the three TAG_SCAN rows, including near-miss, and the exact intended unreached set on both CPU paths. Preserve margins, capped-run lower-bound meaning, derived extrema/geometric mean, source/tool/case digests and all existing applicable checks. Add the original B6 (<10 runs), B9 (an unmeasured census line/site) and M5 (deleted plural mutant row) as fail cases to the successor build_record_mutants.py, with corresponding controls and missing/duplicate/wrong-identity coverage. Removing an observation must fail even when all remaining summaries and margins are internally consistent.

[Inferred claim and diagnostic matrix; original items 5–8] Narrow emit_equal.mjs and the successor builder/record claims to what is actually compared: equality of TypeScript-transpiled JavaScript for the named test files, comments removed and CPU-bound constants masked, using the recorded tree's compiler/options. It does not prove equivalent test execution, unchanged runner pragmas/config/environment, unchanged imported modules, or unchanged timed-region CPU. Preserve the type-only acceptance qualification. Include the @vitest-/@jest-pragma counterexample and a changed transitive region module as limitations; do not assert that source differences are only comments/types/bounds merely from equal masked emits. Where a current CPU claim is retained, establish actual applicability of raw subject/test/config/pragma/import-closure bytes separately, or remeasure the invalidated arm at the current subject. Unproved current timing is Unknown; a scoped claim correction does not itself mandate repeating unaffected historical work or permit treating old timings as new.

Match dossier/polaris conditions structurally after unwrapping parentheses: ===, argv[0] element access, matching string-literal text. The original double quotes, whitespace and parentheses equivalents G5–G7 must pass this predicate while comma-expression, wrong argument/name/operator, duplicate/missing branches, unexpected else, after-daemon placement and app mentions outside runtime branch blocks fail at the intended property. Every assertion names the branch and failed property, not a raw array/boolean mismatch. At the retained pin comment use 'Among its false refusals', name G1's Allman/wrapped-import shape and G2's block-comment shape, and keep the previously correct five. Add G1–G3 as equivalent probe cases derived byte-for-byte from the retained r3_variants.py definitions before any necessary explicit current-source retargeting; extend PIN_FALSE_REFUSALS and record row outcomes accurately. These are pin false refusals, not runtime loads or unexplained green equivalents. Open the compiler row's comment 'The compiler-API text row.' The whole old pin remains below it; do not call it a kept fragment.

[Inferred proof budget and evidence integrity] Any daemon-entry test edit, even a comment, requires all four daemon-entry campaigns again in the same PR: repaired test, base test, prior test and round-1 test, with their actual source versions identified. Bind each run to the exact main.ts/state-directory.ts/shutdown.ts/current-test inputs and the separate chosen test-copy digest. Use a newly adapted private probe; retain every attempt and compare all four actual mutant populations. Required historical hook absence is the only predecessor-specific skip; source-fragment mismatch, collection failure, zero executed rows, unrelated failure or timeout is not a kill. Every added/changed checker or behavioral predicate gets a valid control, exact old/new mutation, intended defect-naming assertion/refusal, restoration control, tool/input hashes and a reachable subject commit. Keep original witnesses and add Y1b, G1–G3, B6/B9/M5 and the actual island/machine/close-failure witnesses; reuse the nearest seam rather than create a new permanent mutation framework. Reconcile inherited K/B cases to changed row semantics individually; a formerly pin-alone failure cannot be required after a new row correctly catches it.

Rebuild a new complete record with current subject/diff hashes, source/case/tool identities, exact populations, per-row attributions, current/historical reuse map and residuals. A second rebuild must be byte-identical and leave no source/evidence drift. Do not run the historical builder unchanged at current main: its hard-coded location, frozen result writer, main/base comparison and pin expectations concern its own old subject. Apply the current builder checks to the successor data and keep old record bytes intact. Maintain the historical main-versus-EVIDENCE and later-main distinctions; original separation, closure and test-source commits never silently become the landing subject. The round-4 closure note (support/index.ts and dossier-profile.test.ts had changed outside the emit comparison) remains historical; recalculate the actual current closure/moved-input population before evidence reuse or landing. No old summary, partial row list or historical 17-row count substitutes for current runner discovery.

[Inferred class and floor declaration for fresh contest] Initial expected CC-REV-1 classes are 1 (daemon/adapter boundary evidence), 4 (parked-island/security load evidence) and 6 (CLI/machine-facing behavior evidence), consistent with the former review but independently reassessed for this actual diff. Classes 2 (identity minting/continuity), 3 (observation snapshot/evaluation/inferred seam), 5 (schema/store migration) and 7 (future certificate logic) are not anticipated because their implementation is outside this test/evidence change; any actual touch is declared and reviewed, never waived by that anticipation. All seven CC-BAR-5 floors remain binding: truth—faithful behavior/row/claim semantics and no secrets; evidence—exact current subjects, complete populations and Unknown when absent; inference—label interpretation and never promote an author report to gate evidence; write—no new product write path or adapter authority; sign-off—no adopted/normative/security-posture change; security—fixture-owned authenticated routes, no observed code/provider egress/credential disclosure; identity—no reminted identities or schema migration. The reviewer confirms or revises each declaration. Classes 1/4 require GP-Q0's old/new differential on mutated records including altered prose, rule-6 mutants per predicate, and the non-blocking cycle notice through the coordinator's syzygy-bpyt.10 report. Intended checker refusals are recorded as test/evidence deltas, never passed off as product-gate changes.

[Inferred execution, checks and lawful landing] This dispatch performs none of those runs or source edits. A future sole writer refreshes the committed source/ownership first, prepares the common contract's fixture-only execution boundary and short private HOME/cache/TMPDIR/Git roots, stages the exact public-lockfile tarball set before DNS-free offline npm ci, and completes npm ci inside the allocated checkout before NodeNext. Evidence mutants are separate from permanent-test counts; any additional guard-body change is counted honestly and justified against existing coverage.

Use current CONTRIBUTING Checking a change: during work npm run check plus the focused system-config daemon-entry file (build first), and the focused unit island test only if touched. Before PR, one serialized npm run check:all at the final clean committed subject in a fresh npm-ci clone, using the canonical PROJECT-STATUS.md battery through check:battery, not copied commands. Serialize broad execution on /home/orca/.tmp/syzygy-full-suite-20261104.lock; never restart a live gate to obtain a result. Preserve every failed/interrupted attempt, its exact subject/denominator and unreached stages; CC-TEST-4 forbids author-only infrastructure classification or retry-until-green. Scope any repeated check to a justified changed subject/repair; do not rerun an unchanged passing full gate. Gate evidence needs emitter-distinct capture under CC-TEST-2/CC-PROV-1, distinct from an author's report, a byte-hash check or an independent execution. Obtain fresh independent exact-head review from the standing artifact/primary references/AC, retain raw output verbatim as a new -RAW.md and register its campaign pattern as needed; no desired verdict or inherited PR532 clearance. Reviewer-authored semantic fixes require another independent reviewer. Retain clear dispositions and all eight item results. Hosted node/checks and merge-group checks must cover the exact landing tree under the current placement/budget. Root alone owns lifecycle, notices and authorized landing.

[Observed standing hold; Inferred applicability] OWNER-DIRECTION-QUESTIONNAIRE-ANSWERS-2026-11-03.md item 4 says “no merge may touch” apps/three-surface-poc/src or packages/three-surface-poc-core/src until BOTH the owner's judgment and cycle report are recorded. A routine engineering decision, a GP-Q0 notice, a passing check or this packet is neither record. Roll back only the cohesive test/successor-tool correction by revert; retained evidence/raws stay immutable. Static shaping can be complete while the original implementation outcome remains OPEN, and this dispatch is not runnable-now implementation or a landing grant.

dependencies.title: Greenfield parity: simplify Syzygy toward its from-scratch shape (audit 2026-10-21)
dependencies.description:
Outcome: Syzygy's implementation plane converges on the shape a from-scratch build of the current specifications would have, without changing any rendered byte, wire format, signed artifact or consent decision. Reviewers should be able to read the code and see one name per concept, one engine per mechanism, and tooling sized to what it guards.

Why: the 2026-10-21 greenfield-parity audit (docs/plans/2026-10-21-greenfield-parity-audit.md) measured main at dd520e8d against an independent from-scratch estimate written before any implementation was read.
- Product TypeScript: 52.7k source lines against a lean greenfield of 30-47k (provider mode parked). After removing 9.2k lines of tooling compiled into the POC app and the 4.8k-line parked provider island, the product runtime is about 38k: near parity in volume. Its residue is structural: duplicated concepts (two owner-act validators whose non-human-principal rules have drifted, two bounded blob readers, 26 sha256 helpers, six epistemic carriers), misplaced tooling, god files and module-global render state.
- Governance tooling: 94k lines (123 files) against a data-driven greenfield of 4.5-7.5k, about 12-20x. 54% (50.4k lines) re-verifies frozen history; the rest is one patch-package lifecycle and one recorder template cloned per act (120 exact-duplicate function groups, 331 copies).
- The evidence and governed estates have no retention rule: docs/evidence holds 388 files, 141 cited by nothing; about 56% of governed lines are spent rounds, history or a byte-identical RFC mirror.

Milestones (each a child epic ending in a reconciliation bead): M1a tooling history and battery; M1b tooling engines; M2 tests, build and CI; M3 POC app; M4a domain-core correctness and primitives; M4b domain-core model and evaluators; M5 Polaris dossier and generation; M6 docs and evidence; M7 owner-gated simplifications (one batched plain-language packet).

Order (progressive, per greenfield-parity): bugs first (guard roots, ls-tree -z, principal drift); then leaf residue; then boundary reshapes; then surface rewrites; owner-gated items only after the owner answers the packet. The final child re-runs the audit and records convergence.

Non-goals: no spec, doctrine, contract or policy change; no behavior change; no deletion of parked provider code; no edits to digest-bound files.

Model tier: Opus-class lead; children carry their own tiers.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
1. Every finding in the audit report maps to a bead (new, attached, reopened or explicitly not filed with a reason).
2. Every milestone epic's reconciliation bead is closed.
3. The convergence bead's re-run reports new 0 and reopened 0 on the remediated head.
